rules.quote: Regardless of who is to blame, the operator and/or owner of a vehicle involved in a reportable crash in this state must file an Owner/Driver Report of the crash to the Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security within 20 days.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Failure to report a crash may result in suspension of driving and registration privileges.
rules.quote: Failure to report a crash may result in suspension of driving and registration privileges.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: If a claim is filed against you, you must show proof of liability insurance at the time of the crash, obtain notarized releases from all claimants, or post cash or corporate surety bond, or your driving and registration privileges will be revoked.
rules.quote: (1) Show proof that you had liability insurance at the time of the crash; (2) Obtain notarized releases from all parties who file claims with the department; or (3) Post cash or corporate surety bond with the department for the amount of damages received by other parties.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: The law requires drivers of vehicles involved in a crash to stop immediately at the scene, or as close to the scene as possible without obstructing traffic.
rules.quote: The law requires drivers of vehicles involved in a crash to stop immediately at the scene, or as close to the scene as possible without obstructing traffic.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Motor vehicle crashes involving property damage, personal injury or death must be reported to the police.
rules.quote: Motor vehicle crashes involving property damage, personal injury or death must be reported to the police.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Do not attempt to move an injured person from a wrecked vehicle unless you have the necessary medical or rescue training or there is an immediate danger such as fire.
rules.quote: Do not attempt to move an injured person from a wrecked vehicle unless you have the necessary medical or rescue training or there is an immediate danger such as fire.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: After a crash you must exchange name, address and driver's license number of other drivers, license plate numbers, names and addresses of anyone injured, names and addresses of witnesses, and insurance policy numbers of other vehicle owners.
rules.quote: name, address and driver's license number of other drivers; • license plate numbers of other vehicles; • name and address of anyone who was injured; • name and address of each witness;

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: If you arrive first at a crash scene, notify the police immediately by calling 911, and if you are not professionally trained to render aid, slowly continue on so as not to interfere with emergency services.
rules.quote: If you are not professionally trained to render aid, slowly continue on in your vehicle so not to interfere with the arrival of police and emergency medical and fire/rescue services.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Tennessee is a member of the Non-Resident Violator Compact, so ignoring a citation issued here or in another member state results in suspension, revocation or cancellation of driving privileges.
rules.quote: If you ignore the citation — whether it was issued for a traffic violation here or in another member state, your driving privileges will be suspended, revoked or canceled.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Speeding 1–5 mph over is 1 point, 6–15 mph is 3 points, 16–25 is 4, 26–35 is 5, 36–45 is 6, and 46 mph and above is 8 points; construction-zone values are higher.
rules.quote: 8 46 m.p.h. and above in excess of speed zone Construction Zone: 8 pts
extraQuotes: 1 1 thru 5 m.p.h. in excess of speed zone Construction Zone: 2 pts

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Reckless driving is 6 points and reckless endangerment by vehicle (misdemeanor) is 8 points.
rules.quote: 8 Reckless endangerment by vehicle-misdemeanor

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Passing a stopped school, church or youth bus taking on or discharging passengers is 8 points.
rules.quote: 8 Passing stopped school, church or youth bus taking on or discharging passengers

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Failure to stop at a railroad crossing is 8 points.
rules.quote: 8 Failure to stop at railroad crossing

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Failure to yield right of way to emergency vehicles, and failure to change lane/slow down for authorized vehicles on the roadside, is 6 points.
rules.quote: 6 Failure to yield right of way to emergency vehicles. Failure to change land/slow down for authorized vehicles on roadside.

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Operating a vehicle while using a cell phone (under 18) is 6 points.
rules.quote: 6 Operating vehicle while using cell phone (under 18)

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Contributing to a crash is 3 points for property damage, 4 points for bodily injury, and 8 points for the death of another person.
rules.quote: 8 Contributing to occurrence of a crash resulting in the death of another person
extraQuotes: 3 Contributing to a crash resulting in property damage
4 Contributing to a crash resulting in bodily injury

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Operating without a driver license in possession is 2 points.
rules.quote: 2 Operating without driver license in possession

rules.group: Driving responsibility — points, suspension, insurance, crashes
rules.rule: Operating while the driver license required for the type of vehicle is under suspension, revocation or cancellation is 8 points.
rules.quote: 8 Operating while driver license required for type of vehicle operated is under suspension, revocation or cancellation

rules.rule: Regardless of the rules of the road or right-of-way, the law specifically requires the driver to exercise great care and extreme caution to avoid striking pedestrians.
rules.quote: Regardless of the rules of the road or right-of-way, the law specifically requires YOU, as a driver, to exercise great care and extreme caution to avoid striking pedestrians.

rules.rule: Drivers should not block the crosswalk when stopped at a red light or waiting to make a turn, and should not stop with a portion of the vehicle over the crosswalk area.
rules.quote: Drivers should not block the crosswalk when stopped at a red light or waiting to make a turn. You also should not stop with a portion of your vehicle over the crosswalk area.

rules.rule: Don't honk your horn, rev your engine or do anything to rush or scare a pedestrian in front of your car, even if you have the legal right-of-way.
rules.quote: Don't honk your horn, rev up your engine or do anything to rush or scare a pedestrian in front of your car, even if you have the legal right-of-way.

rules.rule: On most roadways bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as other roadway users, and are prohibited on limited-access highways, expressways and certain other marked roadways.
rules.quote: On most roadways, bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as other roadway users and in most cases, they must share the lane. Bicyclists are prohibited on limited-access highways, expressways and certain other marked roadways.

rules.rule: Bicyclists are required to travel on the right-hand side of the road in the same direction as vehicles, riding as close to the right as practical while avoiding road hazards.
rules.quote: Bicyclists are required to travel on the right hand side of the road and travel in the same direction as vehicles. They must ride as close to the right side of the road as practical, while avoiding road hazards

rules.rule: If a lane is marked and signed for bicycle use only, drivers must never use that lane as a turning lane, passing lane, or for parking.
rules.quote: If the lane is marked and signed (as shown at right) for bicycle use only, drivers must NEVER use this lane as a turning lane, passing lane or for parking.

rules.rule: A bicyclist should be allowed full use of the lane when overtaking another vehicle, when there are unsafe conditions in the roadway, or when the lane is too narrow to safely share.
rules.quote: The lane is too narrow for both a vehicle and a bicycle to safely share the lane. In this case it is safest to let the bicycle take the full lane.

rules.rule: Tennessee law requires a bicycle used at night to have a front lamp emitting white light visible at least 500 feet to the front, and either a red reflector or a red lamp visible from 500 feet to the rear.
rules.quote: Tennessee law requires that a bicycle used at night must be equipped with a lamp on the front that emits a white light visible from a distance of at least 500 feet to the front and either a red reflector or lamp emitting a red light that is visible from distance of 500 feet to the rear

rules.rule: A bicyclist signals a left turn by extending the left arm out sideways with all fingers extended or pointing left.
rules.quote: Left Turn Extend your left arm out sideways with all fingers extended or use your index finger to point left.

rules.rule: A bicyclist signals a right turn by extending the left arm sideways bent 90 degrees at the elbow with the hand pointing upward and palm facing forward, or alternatively by extending the right arm straight out.
rules.quote: Right Turn Extend your left arm out sideways bent at a 90-degree angle at the elbow joint, hand pointing upward and the palm of hand facing forward.

rules.rule: A bicyclist signals stopping or slowing by extending an arm sideways bent 90 degrees at the elbow with the hand pointing downwards and palm facing backwards.
rules.quote: Stopping or Slowing Extend your left arm or right arm sideways and bend your arm at a 90-degree angle at the elbow joint, hand pointing downwards and the palm of your hand facing backwards.

rules.rule: When your vehicle is turning left and a bicyclist is entering the intersection from the opposite direction, wait for the bicyclist to pass before making the turn.
rules.quote: When your vehicle is turning left and there is a bicyclist entering the intersection from the opposite direction, you should wait for the bicyclist to pass before making the turn.

rules.rule: If your vehicle is turning right and a bicyclist is approaching on the right, let the bicyclist go through the intersection first before making the right turn.
rules.quote: If your vehicle is turning right and a bicyclist is approaching on the right, let the bicyclist go through the intersection first before making a right turn.

rules.rule: At night, do not use high beams when you see an oncoming bicycle rider.
rules.quote: At night, do not use high beams when you see an oncoming bicycle rider.

rules.rule: A bicyclist with a red or orange pennant flag on an antenna is commonly indicating impaired hearing, so slow down.
rules.quote: If you see a bicyclist with a red or orange pennant flag on the antennae attached to the bike, slow down: this is a common symbol to indicate the rider has impaired hearing.

rules.rule: Motorcycles have the right to the use of the full lane, and you must never try to share a lane with a motorcycle.
rules.quote: You must never try to share a lane with a motorcycle, and you should always respect the cycle's space and position in traffic.
extraQuotes: Motorcycles have the right to the use of the full lane

rules.rule: Allow at least a two-second following distance behind a motorcycle so the rider has enough time to maneuver or stop in an emergency.
rules.quote: Following Distance - Allow at least a two-second following distance, so the motorcycle rider has enough time to maneuver or stop in an emergency.

rules.rule: A motorcyclist must never ride in between lanes in traffic or share a lane with another vehicle.
rules.quote: Never ride in between lanes in traffic or share a lane with another vehicle.

rules.rule: Large trucks have blind spots (No-Zones) around the front, back and sides, and if you can't see the truck driver in the truck's mirror, the truck driver can't see you.
rules.quote: if you can't see the truck driver in the truck's mirror, the truck driver can't see you.

rules.rule: The area approximately up to 20 feet directly in front of a large vehicle is considered a NO-ZONE.
rules.quote: The area approximately up to 20 feet directly in front of a large vehicle is considered a NO-ZONE.

rules.rule: A truck's blind spots are immediately in front, on either side, and up to 200 feet in the rear.
rules.quote: A truck's blind spots are immediate in front, on either side of the car and up to 200 feet in the rear.

rules.rule: If a tractor has a long hood, the trucker may not be able to see the first 10-20 feet in front of the bumper.
rules.quote: If the tractor has a long hood, the trucker may not be able to see the first 10-20 feet in front of the bumper

rules.rule: Trucks make wide right turns and often leave an open space on the right; do not move into that space or try to pass a truck that might be making a right turn.
rules.quote: Trucks make wide right turns and often must leave an open space on the right side. Do NOT move into that space or try to pass a truck if it might be making a right turn.

rules.rule: When passing a large vehicle, do not pull back into the lane in front of the truck unless you can see the whole front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.
rules.quote: do NOT pull back over into the lane in front of the truck unless you can see the whole front of the vehicle in your rearview mirror.

rules.rule: If the truck or bus driver blinks their headlights after you pass, it is a signal that you are cleared to pull back in front of their vehicle.
rules.quote: If the truck or bus driver blink their vehicle headlights after you pass, it's a signal that you are cleared to pull back in front of their vehicle.

rules.rule: Vehicles should never stop or park in runaway truck ramps.
rules.quote: Runaway Truck Ramps: These ramps are designed to stop out-of-control trucks or buses going down step downgrades. Vehicles should never stop or park in these areas.

rules.rule: When you are near a Commercial Vehicle Weigh Station, avoid driving in the right lane so slow-moving trucks can easily merge back onto the roadway.
rules.quote: When you are near a Commercial Vehicle Weigh Station, avoid driving in the right lane so slow-moving trucks can easily merge back onto the roadway.

rules.rule: The slow-moving vehicle emblem, a fluorescent or reflective orange triangle, must be displayed on the rear of vehicles drawn by animals and most farm vehicles and construction equipment.
rules.quote: The "slow moving vehicle" emblem, a fluorescent or reflective orange triangle, must be displayed on the rear of vehicles drawn by animals, and most farm vehicles and construction equipment.

rules.rule: Farm machinery usually does not have turn signals, and to make a right turn operators may first pull wide to the left, then turn right.
rules.quote: Farm machinery usually does not have turn signals and to make a right turn, operators of farm machinery may first pull wide to the left, then turn to the right.

rules.rule: Animal-drawn vehicles have the same rights to use the road as a motor vehicle and must follow the same rules of the road.
rules.quote: They have the same rights to use the road as a motor vehicle and must follow the same rules of the road.

rules.rule: Horseback riders are subject to and protected by the rules of the road, must ride single file near the right curb or edge, and the law requires you to exercise due care, drive at a reasonable speed and distance, and not sound your horn or rev your engine.
rules.quote: You must drive at a reasonable speed, and at a reasonable distance away from the horse. Do NOT sound your horn or "rev" your engine loudly when approaching or passing a horse.
extraQuotes: The law requires you to exercise due care when approaching a horse being ridden or led along a road

rules.rule: When lights are required for slow-moving vehicles, a self-luminous red lamp on the rear is normally visible for 500 feet to the rear.
rules.quote: a self-luminous red lamp on the rear of the vehicle is normally visible for 500 feet to the rear.

rules.rule: Slower traffic must drive in the right-hand lane; the left lane is for passing and turning.
rules.quote: Slower traffic must drive in the right-hand lane. The left lane is for passing and turning.

rules.rule: Watch for the color orange — it always means "road work—slow down", and all temporary signs in work zones have an orange background with black letters or symbols.
rules.quote: Watch for the color orange – it always means: "road work—slow down". All temporary signs in work zones have an orange background and black letters or symbols.

rules.rule: Follow the instructions of work zone signs and flaggers, and don't change lanes within the work zone unless instructed to do so.
rules.quote: Follow their signals, and don't change lanes within the work zone unless instructed to do so.

rules.rule: Turn on your vehicle's headlights before you enter the work zone to become more visible to workers and other motorists.
rules.quote: Turn your lights on before you enter the zone! Turn on your vehicle's headlights to become more visible to workers and other motorists.

rules.rule: Observe the posted work-zone signs until you see the one that says "End Road Work".
rules.quote: Observe the posted signs until you see the one that says "End Road Work".

rules.rule: School buses, passenger buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials must stop at all railroad crossings whether signals are activated or not, and you should never attempt to pass these stopped vehicles on a two-way road.
rules.quote: School Buses, Passenger Buses and Trucks carrying hazardous materials must stop at all crossings whether signals are activated to not. Never attempt to pass these stopped vehicles on a two-way road.

rules.rule: Where there is more than one track, a driver waiting for one train to pass must make sure another train is not approaching from the opposite direction.
rules.quote: Where there is more than one track, a driver waiting for one train to pass must make sure another train is not approaching from the opposite direction.

rules.rule: If you are crossing the tracks and the warning lights begin flashing or the gates start coming down, don't stop — keep moving, and never try to back up.
rules.quote: If you are crossing the tracks and the warning lights begin flashing or the gates start coming down, don't stop. KEEP MOVING!
extraQuotes: DO NOT EVER TRY TO BACK UP.

rules.rule: When stopping for a crosswalk on a multi-lane road you should stop about 30 feet before the crosswalk so you do not block visibility of crossing pedestrians to drivers in the other lanes.
rules.quote: When stopping for a crosswalk on a multi-lane road, you should stop about 30 feet before the crosswalk so you do not block visibility of the crossing pedestrians to drivers in the other lane(s).

rules.rule: A minimum four-second gap is needed whenever you change lanes, enter a roadway, or when your lane merges with another traffic lane.
rules.quote: A minimum four-second gap is needed whenever you change lanes, enter a roadway or when your lane merges with another traffic lane.

rules.rule: Defensive drivers try to focus their eyes 10 to 15 seconds ahead, about the distance of one city block.
rules.quote: Defensive drivers try to focus their eyes 10 to 15 seconds (about the distance of 1 city block) ahead.

rules.rule: Use your rearview mirror to check the traffic behind you frequently, about every 10 seconds.
rules.quote: Use your rearview mirror to check the traffic behind you frequently, about every 10 seconds.

rules.rule: Scan the roadway ahead and try to watch 15-20 seconds in front of your vehicle for cars braking, entering or exiting.
rules.quote: Scan the roadway ahead and try to watch 15-20 seconds in front of your vehicle for cars braking, entering or exiting.

rules.rule: Take a break and get out of the car at least every two hours, or every 100 miles or so, and it is safest not to drive more than eight hours per day.
rules.quote: Take a break and get out of the car at least every two hours, or every 100 miles or so.
extraQuotes: It is safest for you and others if you do not drive more than eight hours per day.

rules.rule: When stopping behind a vehicle at an intersection you should be able to see the license plate and/or the other vehicle's back tire where it meets the pavement.
rules.quote: A basic rule of thumb is that you should be able to see the license plate and/or the other vehicle's back tire where it meets the pavement.
